_note: Tier 2, oldest end. 6-9 October 2025: Cubans recruited, the Canada revival, Aztec lineages, the Pentagon message.

mentions.claim_text: An extended passage of glossolalia with no discernible English content.
mentions.quote: old papaya
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: speaking in tongues, with nothing in English to check.

mentions.claim_text: Tongues interspersed with the repeated English word element, with nothing attached to it.
mentions.quote: Element. Element about to say
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a single English word inside tongues, uninterpreted.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees a golden light around them, followed by an extended passage of tongues.
mentions.quote: I see a golden light around them
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: an image of protection with no subject named.

mentions.claim_text: He says Cubans are being offered two thousand dollars each to go and fight, noting the average Cuban earns twenty dollars a month.
mentions.quote: $2,000 a piece. And the average Cuban makes $20 a month
mentions.falsify_match: Cuban nationals recruited to fight for Russia for payment. Reporting on Cuban recruits in the Russian army had been public since 2023.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such recruitment. Both figures are checkable.

mentions.claim_text: He says they will establish a headquarters there as a great front for another Cuban missile crisis, and recalls seeing mules in the middle of the night and a biological something.
mentions.quote: establish a headquarters there for the Cuban missile crisis again
mentions.falsify_match: A Russian headquarters or missile presence established in Cuba.

mentions.claim_text: He says Cuba is being drawn to Russia with promises of financial freedom and of getting out from under the Western boot by joining BRICS, but that they would have to align.
mentions.quote: getting out from underneath the Western boot to join the BRICS
mentions.falsify_match: Cuba joining BRICS on Russian sponsorship.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. Cuba became a BRICS partner country in January 2025, before this was said.

mentions.claim_text: He says they will be extension cords to these nations, that Venezuela was about oil, and recalls seeing a war front trying to happen in the ocean.
mentions.quote: they will be extension cords to these nations
mentions.falsify_match: Naval confrontation off Venezuela.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. American deployments there had begun in August 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are being told everything will be fine if they join BRICS, positioned into a new era of financing, and that he then saw Cuba highlighted.
mentions.quote: telling them everything is going to be okay if you join up with the BRICS
mentions.falsify_match: BRICS financial integration used to pull states from the Western system.

mentions.claim_text: He says Alabama was brought up and he saw the Alabama area, and that he told them to pray over Alabama, over Texas and over the college campuses.
mentions.quote: You need to pray over Alabama. You need to pray over Texas
mentions.falsify_match: An incident at an Alabama or Texas college campus.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Two named states and a setting, though no act is specified.

mentions.claim_text: He urges grandparents and parents to go round praying and pleading the blood over their areas, naming college and high school football games.
mentions.quote: football games and high school football games
mentions.falsify_match: An attack at a school or college football game.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. A petition rather than a forecast.

mentions.claim_text: He says that without being grounded in love and founded on the word, fear will dominate a person to the point they cannot live a normal life, even because of what he is saying.
mentions.quote: fear will dominate you to the point you cannot live a normal life
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: pastoral advice, and an unusual acknowledgement that his own material can produce fear.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer calling revival over South America, Australia and all these areas, and that God visit the government officials and the nation.
mentions.quote: OVER SOUTH AMERICA, AND OVER AUSTRALIA, WE ARE CALLING FORTH REVIVAL
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a petition.

mentions.claim_text: He says revival will come again in the college campuses, naming Harvard, Princeton, Yale, USC, Oklahoma and Florida.
mentions.quote: from Harvard to Princeton to Yale to USC to OU to Florida
mentions.falsify_match: A campus revival movement across those named universities.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Six named institutions, which makes it checkable.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that people turn away from lukewarmness, be filled with the Holy Ghost, and be salt and light so others see a difference.
mentions.quote: To not be lukewarm, to be filled with the Holy Ghost
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a petition.

mentions.claim_text: He declares that help is on the way with angels aid and assistance, and says the Lord took him from there to Canada.
mentions.quote: HELP IS ON THE WAY. ANGELS AID AND ASSISTANCE
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a declaration.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees the giant of the church rising up in Canada.
mentions.quote: I see the giant rising up in Canada
mentions.falsify_match: A visible church mobilisation in Canada.

mentions.claim_text: He says there are more with them than against them and that they will start to see signs and wonders like they would not believe.
mentions.quote: There are more that are with you than there are with them
mentions.falsify_match: Documented signs and wonders in Canada.

mentions.claim_text: He says that from sea to sea there will be a major revival in Canada, and that it will come out of persecution.
mentions.quote: From sea to sea, you will have a major revival in Canada
mentions.falsify_match: A nationwide Canadian revival following persecution.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The order, persecution then revival, is the checkable part.

mentions.claim_text: He says no matter how hard they try to suppress or silence what is about to happen in the church in Canada, the glory will rise within them.
mentions.quote: NO MATTER HOW HARD THEY TRY TO SILENCE YOU
mentions.falsify_match: Attempted suppression of the Canadian church followed by growth.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Framed so that suppression confirms it and absence of suppression does not refute it.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord is taking a different direction and told him to go back to Canada, and explains he struggles when he tries to pause the vision.
mentions.quote: when I am trying to pause the vision
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a note about how the visions arrive.

mentions.claim_text: He says it goes down to the Aztec and into the Spanish, referring to the ancient Aztec and the Maya, and that there is a lineage.
mentions.quote: the ancient Aztec and the Mayans. There is a lineage
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: a hidden bloodline running back to Mesoamerica.

mentions.claim_text: He refers to human sacrifice among the Aztec and Maya and great witchcraft around the pyramids, telling them to look at the walls.
mentions.quote: the sacrifices of the humans. Great witchcraft
mentions.falsify_match: Not a forward claim: a description of documented ancient practice.

mentions.claim_text: He says it goes into South America and there are lineages, admits this is way out there and that he never expected it, and says he will talk about more if he sees it live.
mentions.quote: This is way out there today. I have never expected this
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: bloodlines with no observable test, and he flags the strangeness himself.

mentions.claim_text: He says he can see it clearly and that the Asian one fascinates him most, with the dragons, and that it goes over into somewhere else.
mentions.quote: The one that is very fascinating to me is the Asian one
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: a lineage traced through Asian dragon symbolism.

mentions.claim_text: He points to Australia acting on Palestine and Israel and calls it prophecy unfolding and a watchman unfolding, happening as they speak.
mentions.quote: This is prophecy unfolding. This is a watchman unfolding
mentions.falsify_match: Not a forward claim: current news read as fulfilment. Australia recognised Palestinian statehood on 21 September 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He warns about what happens if New York City gets the mayor everybody thinks is the greatest, promising free health care and other things.
mentions.quote: if you get that mayor that everybody is thinking he is the greatest
mentions.falsify_match: Adverse consequences in New York following the November 2025 mayoral election.
mentions.falsify_miss: None attributable. Given a month before the vote.

mentions.claim_text: He recounts deciding to come up with an idea, detailing cars or similar, and says God gave them eBay and Poshmark, selling things found at thrift shops.
mentions.quote: God gave us eBay and Poshmark
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: personal history about making a living.

mentions.claim_text: He says everything he tells them is coming and it is right there in the news, and asks whether anyone remembers watch the opera house, offering to make a short about it.
mentions.quote: Watch the opera house. Does anybody remember that?
mentions.falsify_match: An event at an opera house, most plausibly Sydney.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The building is not identified in this passage.

mentions.claim_text: He says he has a big responsibility, that the Lord keeps telling him he must pray, and that they are able to divert and stop things.
mentions.quote: as we are able to divert things, stop things
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: the diversion premise stated, which is the mechanism by which unmet warnings are read as successes.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw a man in the Pentagon taking a deciphered message and giving it to somebody in Europe, and then Europe onward.
mentions.quote: I saw the man in the Pentagon taking a deciphered message
mentions.falsify_match: A Pentagon leak of classified material to a European recipient.
mentions.falsify_miss: None disclosed. A named building and a named destination.
